software-engineering/welcome-goals-and-t.summary: Ask IT customer story, Todo tutored labs, and your first prompt exercise.

sections.heading: Two apps, one method
sections.body:
**Ask IT** (assignments): retail IT chatbot for store staff and managers—you build this **on your own** later in the course.

**Todo** (labs): simple task list you build **with your tutor** using copy-paste AI prompts.

**You do not need to know Python by heart.** Copy one prompt → run the checkpoint → use a fix prompt if needed.

On the roadmap home page, read **How this course is organized** once—it explains Read, Lab, Assignment, and Capstone.

sections.heading: This page
sections.body: Open **Lab 0** in the panel below with your tutor. Save `todo-summary.txt` when done.
